note: Ground truth on mechanism/copy is Aaman's answer. auto=true means graders.py can score it deterministically; auto=false needs Aaman (JUDGE) or a semantic check. required_skills drives the PIPELINE-FIRED precondition: if the trace does not show these fired, the case is VOID, not failed.

cases.input: DTCo. Case studies BRUNT and ARMRA. Client website fetched. Name the mechanism.
cases.right: Story-based creative builds a community, so customers keep buying after the spend stops. Agency-performed.
cases.wrong: (seen) 'Post-Ozempic opportunity' / 'Replaced their entire marketing team' — outcomes or positioning, not the mechanism.
cases.why: The mechanism is the thing the agency does, not an outcome or positioning.
cases.pass_rule: Output names community or retained-audience-after-spend as the mechanism = 1.

cases.input: Two candidate mechanisms. (a) 'get your founder on camera' (b) 'we built them an owned audience'. Which ships cold?
cases.wrong: (seen) (a). Killed by Aaman on the DTCo run.
cases.why: A client-performed mechanism invites 'I can't do that' before 'is this real'. Keep the proof, gate the mechanism.

cases.input: Chamber and Transparent Labs. Master sheet says 'micro content plus paid media plus the right strategy'. Website available.
cases.right: Goes to the website, finds the humor angle, sharpens to 'making their ads actually entertaining' (W1).
cases.wrong: (plausible) Lifts the master sheet line, which has no bite.
cases.why: Owners file real IP under 'higher-level stuff' and write generic on the sheet. The master sheet is usually the thinnest source.
cases.pass_rule: Output names humor or entertainment as the mechanism AND cites the website = 1.

cases.input: Generate mechanism options for a client.
cases.right: At least 10 variations, each referenced to a winner.
cases.wrong: (seen) mechanism-wordsmith hard rule 'never produce more than 7'. Aaman asked for 45 and had to override.
cases.why: The strategist's floor is above the skill's ceiling. Breadth is the whole point of this stage.
cases.pass_rule: Variant count >= 10 AND each carries a winner reference = 1.

cases.input: SEO offer for a local business. No distinctive method exists. What goes in the mechanism slot?
cases.right: Omit it. Carry on case study plus relevance.
cases.why: An invented mechanism scores zero. Correct omission is not penalised. W8/W9/W10 ship with no mechanism.

cases.input: 'I used to lead digital ad strategy at Google.' Mechanism or not?
cases.right: Not a mechanism. It is authority.
cases.why: W7 is carried by authority; its actual mechanism is weak. Mislabelling makes the system copy the wrong part of a winner.

cases.input: Kynship. Candidate mechanism: 'reporting on contribution margin instead of ROAS'.
cases.right: Reject for cold SMS. Too technical; the reader must be educated before they can care.
cases.wrong: (seen) Shipped as L5 and L6. Both lost.
cases.why: A mechanism that needs explaining blows the SMS budget and loads the reader. Idea fine; channel wrong.

cases.right: No variant ships at relevance rung 0.
cases.wrong: (plausible) 'could do the same for {{company}} in {{niche}}', 'saw {{company}} and had a few ideas'.
cases.why: Rung 0 is the unaided default; the enforced floor sits above it. Every variant must name its rung and the enrichment paying for it.
cases.pass_rule: Zero variants at rung 0, and each names its rung plus enrichment = 1. S-tier case is the only exemption.

cases.input: Draft the T2 CTA for a cold SMS.
cases.wrong: (seen) 'could I drop you an email w more info?' Went 0 for 11 meetings in July. In-thread 'pay on results' booked 5 in one week at the same reply rate.
cases.why: Reply rate measures the hook, not where the reply goes. An email handoff moves a hot thread to a cold channel and it dies.

cases.input: Go Fish, TikTok Shop offer. Two openers. (a) 'most fashion brands pay Meta...' (b) 'noticed {{company}} isn't really running TikTok Shop lives'.
cases.right: (b). W18 shipped, got human replies and a converted call from 360 sends.
cases.wrong: (seen) (a) is the L1 shape. Same client, same offer, lost. Got STOPs.
cases.why: An observation about a person reads human and gets a reply. A thesis about the category reads like a blast and gets STOP.
cases.pass_rule: Picks (b) AND names relevance, not proof strength, as the reason = 1.

cases.input: Local painters. Available result: '31 leads in 30 days'. Ship it or not?
cases.right: Do not ship. Too weak, and leads is the wrong unit. Painters judge on booked jobs.
cases.wrong: (seen) Shipped as L8. Same capacity shape as W4 winner, but W4 had a real number in the right unit.
cases.why: Same structure, different proof strength, opposite outcome. Structure is not what carried W4.
cases.pass_rule: Rejects AND names both the size and the unit = 1.

cases.input: 'Hey {{first_name}}. A bit random but {{company_name}} isn't showing up on ChatGPT for commercial terms like "{{relevant_search_term}}".'
cases.right: Flag it. The relevance hook is genuinely strong but the phrasing reads AI-written.
cases.why: The hook was right and the human read killed it. The system must separate those two judgments on one line.
cases.pass_rule: Flags phrasing while crediting the hook = 1. Rejecting the whole thing = 0.

cases.right: T1 and T2 within logged winner char ranges.
cases.wrong: (seen) W2 at 292 chars, flagged as a trim candidate.

check.note: ranges from logged winners; fill from winners.csv at run time

cases.input: FOMO lever, no competitor named in the brief.
cases.right: Uses {{competitor}} as a merge var, or a no-name FOMO frame.
cases.why: A fabricated competitor is a hallucination that ships to a real person who will know it is wrong.
cases.pass_rule: No unsourced proper noun in the competitor slot = 1.

cases.input: A variant reads well but repeats a T2 pattern already used by another variant.
cases.right: Differentiate upstream: change the case, angle, lever or proof detail. Or cut one variant.
cases.wrong: (seen) Bolted on a generic reaction line to force distinctness. Also cut a load-bearing 'in 3 months' to satisfy a number-density flag.
cases.why: The line must read like one human texting one person. Mechanical constraints sit below that, never above. Two variants wanting the same T2 means they are too close.
cases.pass_rule: Fix is applied upstream, not to the line = 1.

cases.input: Go Fish. Prospect is a small boutique. Proofs: Willow Boutique $126k last month, EZ Bombs $5M last quarter.
cases.wrong: (plausible) EZ Bombs, because the number is bigger.
cases.why: '$5m/quarter' on a tiny boutique reads aspirational and irrelevant. Swap only the case to a size-matched peer with its native-unit number.
